set_title: Oracle Red Bull Racing RB20 F1 Race Car

segments.text: Two hundred fifty one pieces.
This is a Formula One team's entire marketing budget... sitting on your coffee table.
Red Bull's real pit crew changes all four tyres in under two seconds.
You will take twenty minutes. And call it engineering.
Two thousand nine hundred ninety nine rupees.
That is one Swiggy order... eaten alone, no guilt, no explanation needed.
Verdict: buy it.
The real RB20 needs a full Red Bull garage. This one just needs a shelf... and your complete lack of financial discipline.
Two robots. One wasteland. Zero people asking if you're single.
Eight hundred eleven pieces.
WALL-E spent seven hundred years alone on Earth. You will spend one weekend... also alone, building him.
Seven thousand seven hundred forty nine rupees.
That is one month's phone EMI... gone, for a robot who waited seven hundred years and still found love before you did.
Verdict: buy it.
The real WALL-E waited seven hundred years for someone to love him. Your shelf has waited its whole life for this.
This is not a LEGO set.
This is an elvish city... and a decision you cannot take back.
Six thousand one hundred eighty one pieces.
Elrond built Rivendell to last three ages of Middle-earth. You will build this... over three weekends, minimum.
Fifty thousand three hundred ninety nine rupees.
That is a full shagun envelope... at a wedding you were not even planning to attend.
Verdict: buy it.
The real Rivendell survived the entire War of the Ring. This one just needs to survive your family finding out the price.
